title: Chigaro cheChokwadi
intro: Mutongi ane simba, anozivikanwa neuchenjeri hwake hukuru nechigaro chake cheumambo chinoyevedza, anogamuchira meseji isinganzwisisike kubva kwaasingazivikanwe. Kutaurirana uku kusingatarisirwi kunoedza zvavanotenda nesimba ravo, zvichivaisa parwendo rwezvematongerwo enyika ruchaedza pfungwa dzavo uye pakupedzisira rwunotungamira mukumuka kwakadzama kwemweya. Unogona here kuburitsa pachena hunhu hwemutongi uyu nezviitiko zvakachinja umambo hwavo hwese?
clues: Ini nevanhu vangu tainamata zuva, tichitevera nzira dzemadzitateguru edu.
Shiri, mhumhu, ndiyo yakanga iri nhume isingatarisirwi yakandiunzira tsamba yakabva kumutungamiriri ane simba.
Kuti ndiedze uchenjeri hwemunhu akatuma, ndakatumira zvipo zvinokosha, asi zvakadzoserwa, sezvo munhu akatuma aiva nepfuma yakawanda kubva kuna Allah.
Ndisati ndasvika padare remunhu akatuma, chigaro changu chinoyevedza chakatakurwa zvinoshamisa ipapo nekukuruma kweziso.
Pandakasvika, ndakabvunzwa kana chigaro chakatakurwa chaive changu, uye ndakapindura ndichiti, 'Zvakaita sekunge ndicho chaicho.'
Ndakapinda muhoro huru ine pasi randaifunga kuti idziva remvura, uye panguva iyoyo yekutya, ndakazviisa pasi paMuporofita Sulaiman kuna Allah, Ishe wepasi rose.

trial.answer: Kugamuchira tsamba kubva kuna Muporofita Sulaiman

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
